name: Halverson IronFlece Zip-Off Liner Jacket
description: A mid-layer fleece jacket with a full front zip and detachable sleeves that convert it to a vest in under thirty seconds. Pewter grey brushed synthetic fleece with reinforced elbow patches in darker charcoal. Sits slim enough to layer under a shell or wear exposed on a mild afternoon without looking like a construction site.
functionality: Zip-off sleeves for vest conversion; slim-cut for under-shell layering; reinforced elbow patches for abrasion resistance.
what_it_says: You dress for function but you've thought about it enough that the function looks intentional.
story_hooks: The right sleeve zipper has been replaced with a different brand — whoever repaired it had access to parts that don't match the original spec.
A Tier-2 transit union patch is ironed onto the left chest, though nothing else about the wearer suggests union membership.

physical_description.visual_profile: A streamlined mid-layer piece that reads as both utilitarian and refined. The slim silhouette suggests function without bulk, maintaining a professional appearance whether fully sleeved or converted to vest form. The pewter grey creates a neutral, corporate-adjacent aesthetic that bridges Tier 3 and lower Tier 2 sensibilities.
physical_description.fit: Slim, tailored through the torso with articulated sleeve construction that allows clean detachment. Sits close to the body without compression, designed for layering efficiency. Cuffs are elasticated for adjustable wrist closure.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed synthetic fleece with high recovery rate—durable enough for repeated wear and wash cycles. Charcoal reinforcement patches are ballistic-weave composite for impact and abrasion resistance.
physical_description.texture: Soft, napped surface on the outer fleece layer with a subtle sheen from synthetic fibers. Reinforced patches have a tighter weave texture, creating deliberate visual contrast. Inner face is smooth, designed for moisture management.
physical_description.color_scheme: Pewter grey as primary, with charcoal grey reinforcement at elbows. Subtle tonal variation prevents the piece from reading as flat or monotone. No visible branding stripes or accent colors.
physical_description.closures: Full-length central YKK-grade zipper with textile pull tab. Sleeve attachment points use magnetic snap connectors—Halverson proprietary—engineered for one-handed release and rapid reconfiguration. No buttons or friction seals.
distinctive_features: Detachable sleeves with secure magnetic snap anchors
Reinforced charcoal elbow patches with visible topstitching
Articulated sleeve construction for clean separation
Interior chest pocket with zippered closure
Laser-cut side vents for ventilation without compromising structure
Tonal embossed Halverson & Mäki branding on left chest
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 functional with Tier 2 crossover appeal. Quality and design suggest working-professional or field-operative budget consciousness paired with durability expectations.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals industrial pragmatism without performative toughness. Worn by maintenance crews, field engineers, logistics specialists, and corpo field staff who prioritize adaptability. The modular design appeals to people whose environments shift between climate-controlled offices and exposed work zones.
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically seen in broken-in condition with minor pilling in high-friction areas. Fleece surface softens with wear but maintains structural integrity. Elbow patches darken with age and actual use marks them as functional, not decorative.

image_prompt: A neo-noir fashion photograph of a Halverson IronFlece jacket displayed on a sleek dark mannequin with one sleeve actively detaching via magnetic snap, the connector point subtly glowing. Pewter grey brushed fleece under moody blue-grey studio lighting with industrial concrete wall backdrop. Close-up detail visible on reinforced charcoal elbow patch with topstitching. Dramatic side-angle composition emphasizing the modular engineering. Deep shadows, cool temperature palette, minimalist product photography aesthetic. --ar 2:3 --v 6
